name: Tsukinami Shin
source:
[spoiler]Shin Tsukinami is the younger brother of the founders. He is the second son of Krone and Giesbach, the former First Blood king.

Shin is a very sadistic character. He takes pleasure in others' misery and pain. He looks down upon everyone aside from his brother. Shin enjoys pranking, torturing or humiliating the heroine. He also likes to make her feel embarrassed.[spoiler]
translation:
[spoiler]Shin Tsukinami is the younger brother of the founders. He is the second son of Krone and Giesbach, the former First Blood king.

Shin is a very sadistic character. He takes pleasure in others' misery and pain. He looks down upon everyone aside from his brother. Shin enjoys pranking, torturing or humiliating the heroine. He also likes to make her feel embarrassed.[spoiler]
